Tony's classmate Mitya suddenly becomes the only one who lends a shoulder. Under the yoke of condemnation from parents and the public, the heroine will have to go through a difficult path.

When a dangerous game of temptation and taboo takes an unexpected turn — a student mysteriously disappears, and everyone believes their secrets will be buried forever. But the arrival of a new face becomes the first domino to fall. The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

show.name: Small Town Remedy
show.summary: This series tells the story of Liu Zhengliang (Played by Xiao Zhan), a genius doctor who suffers a major life setback and is forced to return to his hometown to start over. He gathers a group of seemingly "unreliable" people, and they passionately commit to doing the most reliable, meaningful things. Surrounded by the cozy, bustling neighborhood vibe, they weave warm daily moments with human kindness, offering life prescriptions that heal people's souls.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: My Loong
show.summary: Yue Wangshu, the daughter of a military family, is offered as a sacrifice to the Dragon Abyss. There, she accidentally releases the Dragon Lord Li Zhi. From hostility to mutual understanding, they form an alliance based on a bargain to suppress the Li Fire. She uses the Dragon Lord's power to fight back against the plots of the Yue family and Prince Qi, while he learns human love through her. Ultimately, Li Zhi chooses to remain in the human world, and the two create an epic romance.

show.name: Bionic Trace
show.summary: In 2035, Song Yang, a top student specializing in AI, is falsely accused of murdering his girlfriend and her daughter. While on the run, he teams up with Ada, an android who has developed self-awareness. Together, they solve a series of mysterious cases and uncover the dark secrets of Cedar Group. Eventually, the truth is revealed, and Song Yang clears his name. Ada sacrifices herself to protect him, and humans and androids enter a new era of coexistence.

Wei Tian, a man with top-level protective skills, loses his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack. He assumes a hidden identity in Antilocaris and forms a private security squad called "The Silent Ones" to protect Chinese compatriots living abroad.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: Teach me, Touch me
show.summary: Dumped by his ex for being "too vanilla in bed," Gear decides to reinvent himself into someone confident and irresistible. To make it happen, he seeks out Kanthee, a top-tier playboy and charismatic luxury car mogul, to teach him the art of passion. As these intimate lessons unfold, their intense proximity blossoms into an uncontrollable bond. Kanthee discovers Gear's gentle, intriguing side, while Gear glimpses the genuine heart beneath Kanthee's playboy persona. When the line between lessons and feelings blurs, this thrilling connection might just end in falling in love. One came eager to learn, but the other ended up teaching way beyond the curriculum... In the end, who will fall first?

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

show.name: Mystery Forest
show.summary: Sixteen years ago, on Lunar New Year's Eve, a devastating explosion tore through Zhao Zhiguo's lumber mill in Xinchun, destroying the Zhao family. His son, Zhao Long, miraculously survived but vanished without a trace. Sixteen years later, Zhao Long returns to his hometown under the alias Wang Hong. Using the purchase of Korean pine timber as a cover, he sets out to uncover the truth behind his family's tragedy. Meanwhile, tensions run high in Xinchun as a logging ban on Korean pine disrupts the timber industry, fueling conflicts among powerful businessmen, including Teng Laohu and his son, and Lin Shengli. When a series of murders shakes the town, criminal investigator Cao Jin is assigned to the cases. As Wang Hong navigates mounting dangers, he searches for old Korean pine timber bearing a distinctive paint marking, a crucial clue to the tragedy sixteen years earlier. Along the way, he meets Li Xuefei, a young woman searching for her missing mother, and the two join forces. As their investigation deepens, long-buried clues begin to surface, connecting a string of murders to an intricate timber-smuggling operation. One by one, hidden secrets are exposed, bringing the true culprit into the light. After surviving countless dangers and finally uncovering the truth, Wang Hong makes peace with his painful past and leaves Xinchun behind, ready to begin a new chapter of his life.
